an4.17:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these four ways of taking a wrong course.
an4.17:1.3: One takes a wrong course because of desire, because of hatred, because of delusion, or because of fear.
an4.17:1.4: These are the four ways of taking a wrong course.”
an4.17:2.1:
If through desire, hate, fear, or delusion
one transgresses against the Dhamma,
an4.17:2.4:
one’s fame diminishes like the moon
in the dark fortnight.
